verdicts.reason: A stacks everything into the top ~85%, so the subcopy and button are cramped under a headline that breaks onto a second line with 'fizz' left on its own, and a dead band sits at the bottom. It also moves the yellow circle to the top-left, crowding the logo between two shapes and losing the original's opposite-corner balance. B keeps the headline on one line, spaces the elements more evenly down the canvas and keeps the circles in opposite corners. However, B's yellow circle runs behind the subcopy and button, the subcopy breaks awkwardly at 'sparkling / and lightly sweet', and the button has lost its pill shape and become a rounded rectangle, which is off-brand.
